beats.care: If you ride Metro plus bus to college or work, check the new rates before buying a monthly pass, and do your own math first.
beats.what: Transport minister Ponnam Prabhakar says the Telangana government will review prices of the new Metro and RTC bus common pass after public complaints.
beats.why: The pass costs ₹400 a day or ₹8,500 a month. Many commuters say the monthly pass costs more than buying normal tickets.

cards.body: The pass works on Hyderabad Metro and TGSRTC city buses inside the Outer Ring Road, except Pushpak airport buses. You buy it at any Metro station, with a ₹100 card fee that is refunded when you return the card.
If you mostly ride buses, this digital weekly pass works out far cheaper.
cards.caption: Weekly bus-only pass on the MeeTicket app

cards.body: When it launched, Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju called the common pass a pilot and said changes would follow.

opts: Riders said it costs too much
cards.q: Why is Telangana reviewing the Metro-bus common pass?
cards.why: Many commuters said ₹8,500 a month was more than paying for normal tickets, so the minister ordered a review.

learn.t: Of the ₹8,500 monthly common pass, ₹7,000 is the Metro's share and only ₹1,500 goes to RTC buses.

tldr: Hyderabad's new ₹8,500 monthly Metro-plus-bus pass drew so many complaints that the state government is reviewing its price.
